latestVersion.changelog:
This release clarifies this skill's purpose and platform integration, emphasizing its conceptual and educational function.

- The skill now explicitly describes itself as a conceptual framework for understanding the Umnix jury system and dispute resolution—not a filing or execution interface.
- No direct dispute filing, database access, or system integrations occur through the skill; all resolution actions must be taken on the official Umnix web platform.
- Audience guidance updated: use this skill to learn about jury processes, verdict types, constitutional compliance, and procedural best practices.
- All technical/implementation details now framed as conceptual explanations; all interactive or executional actions are designated as "platform-only."
- Overall, messaging and documentation have been clarified to prevent misunderstandings about capabilities and integration.
